name: Lovely Horror - Ochame na Yuurei
original_name: ラブリーホラー おちゃめなゆうれい
source:
Hero Tatsuya is a school student who decides to rent an apartment. The manager of the apartment is a beautiful girl who tells that her father gone missing and that the apartment is being haunted by ghosts. She asks Tatsuya to get rid of the ghosts and find her father and Tatsuya just can not say "no" to her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学生达也决定租一间公寓。公寓管理员是名美女，她告诉达也，自己的父亲已经失踪，而且公寓近来还在闹鬼。她请达也驱除幽灵并找回父亲，面对这样的她，达也实在无法开口拒绝。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
